core_obligations: Show injectivity by stalks (proof lines 14992-15005): the base change map i^{-1}(F|_{X_{Zar}}) -> (i^{-1}_{small}F)|_{Z_{Zar}} has stalk at z computed as a colimit over elementary etale neighbourhoods (U, u) -> (X, z) with U x_X Z -> Z admitting a section; since etale morphisms are open the image of U -> X is an open neighbourhood U_0 of z, and F(U_0) -> F(U) is injective by the sheaf condition, so the colimit is injective.
Deduce injectivity of F(X) -> (i^{-1}_{small}F)(Z) (proof lines 15007-15009) using assumption (1), and repeat it for every finite X' -> X by assumption (2).

For surjectivity take t in Gamma(Z, i^{-1}_{small}F) and choose an etale covering {V_j -> Z}, etale U_j -> X, sections s_j in F(U_j) and V_j -> U_j over X with t|_{V_j} the pullback of i^{-1}s_j (proof lines 15017-15027); shrink U_j so that V_j -> U_j x_X Z is surjective, obtaining t|_{U_j x_X Z} = i^{-1}s_j and, since every nonempty closed subscheme of X meets Z, the cover coproduct U_j -> X is surjective.

Find a finite surjective X' -> X Zariski locally factoring through the coproduct (proof lines 15028-15036) and pull everything back: t' becomes a section of the subsheaf (i')^{-1}(F'|_{X'_{Zar}}) inside (i'^{-1}_{small}F')|_{Z'_{Zar}} (proof lines 15037-15048).

Apply assumption (2) to lift t' to s' in Gamma(X', F') (proof lines 15049-15052) and use the injectivity already proved plus the case of two pullbacks to show the two pullbacks of s' to X' x_X X' agree on Z' x_Z Z' (proof lines 15052-15056); then the finite-descent remark yields a section of F over X whose pullback to Z is t (proof lines 15057-15059).
proof_roadmap: Injectivity: compute the stalk of the base change map as a colimit over elementary etale neighbourhoods and use the sheaf condition for the etale covering U -> U_0.
Surjectivity: describe t locally as i^{-1}s_j over an etale covering of Z, refine to a surjective coproduct U_j -> X, and replace X by a finite cover X' on which the local descriptions align.

On X', the pulled-back section t' lies in the Zariski subsheaf, so assumption (2) lifts it to s' in Gamma(X', F'); the two pullbacks of s' to X' x_X X' agree, and the finite-descent remark descends s' to X.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is Gabber's h^0 comparison: under the two Zariski section conditions (1) and (2) on Z subset X, the natural map Gamma(X, F) -> Gamma(Z, i^{-1}_{small}F) is bijective for every etale sheaf F (statement lines 14974-14987). The proof has two non-formal halves (proof lines 14989-15069): injectivity is a stalk computation in which the sheaf condition on the etale covering U -> U_0 gives injectivity of F(U_0) -> F(U), and surjectivity requires producing the etale local descriptions of t, refining the coproduct of the U_j to a finite surjective cover X' -> X, lifting the pullback t' by assumption (2), and descending along X' x_X X' via the finite-descent remark. H2: two explicit constructions with a finite cover and a descent step, all written out by the author.
